description: Models domain language, subdomains, bounded contexts, invariants, aggregates, identity, and domain events while delegating dependency, persistence, and delivery mechanics. Project-agnostic; host-specific governance is optional.
user_intent_examples: Determine whether domain complexity justifies DDD and define the smallest evidence-grounded model.
when_to_load: When domain language, invariants, subdomains, or bounded contexts materially drive the design.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for simple CRUD, utility scripts, generic dependency direction, persistence implementation, or messaging delivery mechanics.
